hooks.command: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; for d in "$ROOT/.claude" . .claude .. ../.claude; do [ -f "$d/protect-secrets.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/protect-secrets.sh"; done; exit 0
ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; [ -f "$ROOT/.claude/verify-semver.sh" ] && exec bash "$ROOT/.claude/verify-semver.sh"; exit 0
ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; [ -f "$ROOT/.claude/verify-docs.sh" ] && exec bash "$ROOT/.claude/verify-docs.sh"; exit 0

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.graphifyignore$'; then PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" graphify extract . --force --code-only; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(py|ts|js|go|rs|java|php|cs)$'; then PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" graphify update .; fi || true
hooks.statusMessage: Atualizando Grafo de Conhecimento com Graphify...

hooks.command: (jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | grep -E '\.py$' && make format && make lint) || true
